description: Our grade (A-F) for a Solana or Robinhood Chain token from the holder structure on scanner-bot cards: holders, top-10 share, largest holder, snipers, bundles, dev holding, fresh wallets, curve progress, as numbers, with the penalties that set the grade. Derived fields only; the bots' cards are not reproduced. Covers tokens our desk scanned in the last 48 h; others answer 404 and are not charged. Data rewritten every 30 s; refused (503, not charged) if older than 180 s. Research data from our own paper-trading desk, not trading advice. Costs $0.01 USDC per call (x402).
